recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-8470 unless a new renderer regression is observed in current published extension pages.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request reporting that rendered extension definition pages showed a Summary section with no content; the example was family-member-history-genetics-observation, whose relevant property was valueReference to Observation.
initial_application: Historical commit 733ae77fc0d0ec8ee9bca7199e48a5a480c87813 explicitly applied #8470/svn revision 6676 by changing the old in-repository ProfileUtilities Java renderer so extension summaries include the simple extension value type rather than a blank Extension-only row.
additional_context: The current core checkout no longer contains the historical Java ProfileUtilities renderer, and the cited family-member-history genetics extension definitions are now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. Core still references the genetics extensions from the active FamilyMemberHistory genetics profile, while the Extension Pack source defines family-member-history-genetics-observation as Extension.value[x] Reference(Observation). The current rendered Extension Pack page includes value[x] as Reference(Observation). A later same-family extension rendering issue, FHIR-17073, is already represented on the combined branch and was not duplicated.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The current source and publication surface satisfy the Jira request; any future recurrence would belong in the current publisher or Extension Pack rendering pipeline, not as an unrelated core source edit.
